summary: Renders Huffman-decoded audio samples from a bitstream into a float output buffer. Iterates granule/subband groups (this+0x24B8) and per-granule samples (this+0x24CC), decoding each Huffman symbol through the lookup table dword_5B4788 while advancing the bit cursor this+0x24A8 over the input buffer this+0x24A4, then writes three interleaved float samples using the DCT coefficient table flt_5B10A4 and scale-factor offsets dword_5DA738. Finally zero-fills the trailing output slots for the subband count and, when the channel count is 2, the second half of the buffer.

operations.description: Enters the granule loop only while this+0x24B8 (subband/granule count) is greater than zero.
Enters the per-granule sample loop only while this+0x24CC (samples per granule / channel count) is greater than zero.
Outer loop over this+0x24B8 granules; per iteration the Huffman codebook bit width is read from a6 and a6 advances by 2*(1<<width), then the output base advances one slot.
Output row base v25 = a3 + 64 dwords; each decoded symbol writes three interleaved float samples at row-64, row, row+64.
Reads the next Huffman byte from the input stream and indexes the codebook pair a6[2*value], a6[2*value+1], selecting table entry and sign/scale index.

Decodes a bit-field from the input buffer this+0x24A4 by ANDing the Huffman table entry dword_5B4788 with a byteswapped dword shifted right by the bit cursor this+0x24A8; the cursor is advanced after each symbol.
Combines the decoded index with the scale-factor offset table dword_5DA738 and looks up three float coefficients in the DCT table flt_5B10A4 to write the output samples.
When the Huffman byte is zero, the three output slots for that sample are zero-filled instead of decoded.

A switch on this+0x24B8 zero-fills trailing output slots (first 32 sample lanes, then 64-lane rows, then the 128-lane row) by fallthrough for the mono case; when this+0x24CC equals 2 the second stereo half of the buffer is zero-filled the same way.
Returns this+0x24CC, the channel/sample count used by the caller (value 2 selects the stereo zero-fill path).

clean_pseudocode: if byte == 0: write three zero samples
write three interleaved float samples via DCT/scale tables
zero-fill trailing output slots per subband count (and per stereo channel count 2)
unresolved: The two jump tables jpt_5302EF and jpt_5304EA drive switch dispatch that Hex-Rays collapsed into the fallthrough zero-fill chains; their exact mapping is not pinned down.
The precise relationship between the -64/0/+64 output lane triplets and the subband/stereo layout of a3 is not confirmed.
